Lattice-based cryptography, NIST PQC standards, quantum-safe payments,[^<]+

Kiripitoggirafi bisa lattice, ƙa'idojin NIST PQC, biyan kuɗi mai jure kwantam da barazanar "tattara yanzu, warware daga baya". Rubuce-rubucen bincike, ɗakunan karatu na buɗaɗɗen tushe da jagororin ƙaura ga ƙungiyoyin tsaro na hidimomin kuɗi.
Ƙaurar saƙonni tsakanin ƙasashe, bin ƙa'idar adireshi mai tsari, SEPA Instant, SWIFT gpi da manyan hanyoyin biyan kuɗi da suke ɗauke da komai. Kayan aiki, jagora da jadawalin tsari.
Generative AI, multimodal LLMs, voice, and speech models[^<]+
AI mai ƙirƙira, LLM masu hanyoyi da yawa, murya da samfuran magana — da yadda suke sake tsara ayyukan banki, hidimar abokan ciniki da injiniyancin samfura a manyan cibiyoyi.
Open-source Rust libraries I author and maintain:[^<]+

Ɗakunan karatu na Rust na buɗaɗɗen tushe da nake rubutawa da kula da su: shiga rajista, ƙirƙirar kod, kwanan wata da lokaci, tushen kiripitoggirafi, KEM bisa Kyber da wani janareta na shafukan tsaye da aka rubuta da Rust.
Bitcoin, blockchain fundamentals, ERC-20 tokens, stablecoins,[^<]+
Bitcoin, tushen blockchain, alamun ERC-20, stablecoins da tsarin doka game da hanyoyin biyan kuɗi da kadarorin dijital ke goyan baya.

>A system for real-time speech-to-text transcription that leverages OpenAI Whisper and Metal Performance Shaders GPU acceleration on macOS to achieve sub-second latency at 8-12x real-time on M1 Max\.<

>Tsarin juyar da magana zuwa rubutu a lokaci guda wanda ke amfani da OpenAI Whisper da haɓakar GPU ta Metal Performance Shaders a macOS domin samun jinkiri ƙasa da daƙiƙa ɗaya, sau 8–12 na ainihin lokaci a M1 Max.<
>A new paper suggests Shor\'s algorithm could run on as few as 10,000 qubits\. The threshold for cryptographically relevant quantum computing is dropping fast\.<
>Sabon takarda ya nuna cewa algorithm ɗin Shor na iya gudana da ƙwayoyin ƙubit 10,000 kacal. Matakin lissafin kwantam mai muhimmanci ga kiripitoggirafi yana saukowa da sauri.<
>A bug in Yilei Chen's quantum algorithm for solving LWE has been found, temporarily securing lattice-based cryptography and highlighting the need for ongoing research\.<
>An gano kuskure a cikin algorithm ɗin kwantam na Yilei Chen na warware LWE, wanda ya tsare kiripitoggirafi bisa lattice na ɗan lokaci tare da nuna buƙatar ci gaba da bincike.<
>New quantum algorithm solves a key cryptographic problem, urging accelerated research into quantum-safe security\.<
>Sabon algorithm ɗin kwantam ya warware wata muhimmiyar matsalar kiripitoggirafi, yana kira da a gaggauta bincike kan tsaro mai jure kwantam.<
>How Fully Homomorphic Encryption revolutionises data security in banking and financial services, preserving privacy against quantum-era threats\.<
>Yadda cikakken ɓoye-bayanai na homomorphic ke kawo sauyi ga tsaron bayanai a banki da hidimomin kuɗi, yana kiyaye sirri gaban barazanar zamanin kwantam.<
>An analysis of Apple's MM1 paper on Multimodal Large Language Models — architecture, pre-training strategies and emerging capabilities\.<
>Nazarin takardar MM1 ta Apple kan manyan samfuran harshe masu hanyoyi da yawa — gine-gine, dabarun horo na farko da sabbin iyawa.<
>How IBM Qiskit and the Quantum Fourier Transform reshape credit ratio analysis in finance, offering unprecedented accuracy and speed\.<
>Yadda IBM Qiskit da juyawar Fourier ta kwantam ke sake tsara nazarin rabon bashi a fannin kuɗi, tare da daidaito da gudu da ba a taɓa gani ba.<
>The transformative role of AI inside quantum algorithms for finance, focusing on their mathematical structure and banking applications\.<
>Muhimmiyar rawar AI a cikin algorithms na kwantam don fannin kuɗi, tare da mai da hankali kan tsarinsu na lissafi da amfaninsu a banki.<
>As quantum computers threaten traditional encryption, Quantum Key Distribution \(QKD\) emerges as a structural answer for financial-grade security\.<
>Yayin da kwamfutocin kwantam ke barazana ga ɓoye-bayanai na gargajiya, rarraba maɓalli ta kwantam (QKD) na fitowa a matsayin amsa mai tushe ga tsaro na matakin kuɗi.<
>How CRYSTALS-Kyber, the NIST-selected quantum-resistant key-encapsulation mechanism, is reshaping cryptography for the quantum era\.<
>Yadda CRYSTALS-Kyber, tsarin ɗaure maɓalli mai jure kwantam da NIST ta zaɓa, ke sake tsara kiripitoggirafi na zamanin kwantam.<

Akwai hanyoyi biyu da suke tafiya tare. Takardun farare na masana'antu, waɗanda ake yi wa ƙungiyoyi kamar Emerging Payments Association Asia (EPAA), suna nazarin sauye-sauyen tsari a kayan more rayuwa na biyan kuɗi — kwanan nan tasirin lissafin kwantam mai muhimmanci ga kiripitoggirafi kan hanyoyin sasantawa na manyan biyan kuɗi da na lokaci guda. Rahotannin bincike da aka yi amfani da su suna mai da hankali kan takamaiman batutuwan fasaha (misali: gane magana a lokaci guda da Whisper + Metal Performance Shaders a Apple Silicon) kuma ana fitar da su a matsayin PDF da ake sayan kowanne shi kaɗai.

Ba bisa tsari ba, saboda an fi son inganci fiye da yawan fitarwa. Gajerun rubuce-rubucen bincike na fitowa duk bayan 'yan makonni idan wani ci gaban fasaha ya buƙaci hakan. Ana fitar da takardun farare a daidai da zagayen masana'antu (misali: jadawalin doka, taron EPAA).

Emerging Payments Association Asia (EPAA) ita ce ƙungiyar ƙwararru ta masana'antar biyan kuɗi a yankin Asiya-Pasifik, wadda take haɗa bankuna, masu sarrafa biyan kuɗi, fintech da masu tsara doka kan tambayoyin tsari da suka shafi dukan sashen.

>Open source for the future of finance\.<

Kayan aikin ISO 20022 na pain.001 da pacs.008, karanta bayanan asusun banki, da ɗakunan karatu na Rust don ƙaura zuwa saƙonni masu tsari tsakanin ƙasashe. An gina su don SWIFT, SEPA da tsarin biyan kuɗi na lokaci guda.
Aiwatarwar Rust na CRYSTALS-Kyber (NIST FIPS 203), tushen hash da ginshiƙai masu jure kwantam. Kariya bayan zamanin RSA da lanƙwasar elliptic a tabbatar da ainihi na fannin kuɗi.

Ɗakunan karatu na Rust na buɗaɗɗen tushe don tsara bayanai, shiga rajista, ƙirƙirar kod, kwanan wata da lokaci. Haka kuma Static Site Generator (SSG) da ke gina wannan shafin, da yanayin haɓakawa da ke sa a iya isar da shi.
>ISO 20022 tooling for the global migration\. Pain\.001 file generation, pacs\.008 cross-border credit transfers, and structured bank-statement parsing\.<
>Kayan aikin ISO 20022 don ƙaurar duniya. Ƙirƙirar fayilolin Pain.001, canja wurin bashi tsakanin ƙasashe na pacs.008, da karanta bayanan asusun banki cikin tsari.<
>Rust implementations of CRYSTALS-Kyber, hash and digest primitives, and quantum-resistant building blocks for financial-grade authentication\.<
>Aiwatarwar Rust na CRYSTALS-Kyber, tushen hash da digest, da ginshiƙai masu jure kwantam don tabbatar da ainihi na matakin kuɗi.<
>Basirar wucin gadi da aka yi amfani da ita.<
>Open-source AI projects applying speech recognition, natural language, and large language models to real-world finance and productivity problems\.<
>Ayyukan AI na buɗaɗɗen tushe da ke amfani da gane magana, harshe na ɗabi'a da manyan samfuran harshe kan matsalolin gaske na kuɗi da yawan aiki.<
>A Python library that automates ISO 20022 pain\.001 payment file creation from CSV or SQLite\. Built for the global migration to structured cross-border messages\.<
>Ɗakin karatu na Python da ke sarrafa ƙirƙirar fayilolin biyan kuɗi na ISO 20022 pain.001 daga CSV ko SQLite. An gina shi don ƙaurar duniya zuwa saƙonni masu tsari tsakanin ƙasashe.<

>Generate, validate, and deliver ISO 20022 pacs\.008 payment messages for FI-to-FI customer credit transfers\. JSON Schema \+ XSD validation, IBAN across 75 countries, GDPR/PCI-DSS-compliant PII masking\.<

>Ƙirƙira, tantance da isar da saƙonnin biyan kuɗi na ISO 20022 pacs.008 don canja wurin bashi na abokin ciniki tsakanin cibiyoyi. Tantancewar JSON Schema + XSD, IBAN a ƙasashe 75, ɓoye bayanan sirri bisa GDPR/PCI-DSS.<
>A finance-grade Python toolkit that turns multi-format bank statements into structured data — for the realities of real-world statement files and the audit demands of regulated environments\.<

>Kayan aikin Python na matakin kuɗi da ke juya bayanan asusun banki na tsari daban-daban zuwa bayanai masu tsari — don gaskiyar fayilolin bayanan asusu da buƙatun bincike na yanayin da doka ke tsarawa.<

>A Rust application for optimising cash allocation across complex fund structures using AI-driven forecasting\. Aimed at treasury, fund accounting, and asset-allocation use cases inside banks and asset managers\.<

>Aikace-aikacen Rust don inganta rabon kuɗi a tsakanin hadaddun tsarin asusun zuba jari ta hanyar hasashe da AI ke tafiyarwa. An yi shi don baitulmali, lissafin asusun zuba jari da rabon kadarori a bankuna da masu sarrafa kadarori.<

>A Rust library for generating and manipulating QR-code images in multiple formats\. Direct payment uses include EPC QR Codes for SEPA Credit Transfers, payment-link QR for merchant collection, and step-up authentication flows\.<

>Ɗakin karatu na Rust don ƙirƙira da sarrafa hotunan lambar QR a tsare-tsare da yawa. Amfani kai tsaye a biyan kuɗi: lambobin QR na EPC don canja wurin SEPA, QR na hanyar biyan kuɗi ga ɗan kasuwa, da tsarin ƙarin tabbatarwa.<
>A robust Rust implementation of CRYSTALS-Kyber, the NIST FIPS 203 standard for general-purpose post-quantum key encapsulation\.<
>Ingantacciyar aiwatarwar Rust na CRYSTALS-Kyber, ƙa'idar NIST FIPS 203 ta ɗaure maɓalli bayan-kwantam don amfani gaba ɗaya.<
>Secure hash and digest algorithms for password encryption and verification, designed with a quantum-resistant posture for the post-PQC era\.<
>Ingantattun algorithms na hash da digest don ɓoyewa da tantance kalmomin sirri, an tsara su da tsayuwa mai jure kwantam don zamanin bayan-PQC.<
>A fast, simple, and powerful cross-platform CLI for generating strong, unique, and random passwords backed by audited cryptographic primitives\.<
>CLI mai sauri, mai sauƙi kuma mai ƙarfi da ke aiki a dandamali daban-daban don ƙirƙirar kalmomin sirri masu ƙarfi, na musamman kuma na bazuwa, bisa tushen kiripitoggirafi da aka duba.<
>An advanced voice assistant using OpenAI's GPT for natural interactions, PDF summaries, and efficient caching\. Built for both personal and executive use\.<
>Mataimakin murya na zamani da ke amfani da GPT na OpenAI don hulɗa ta ɗabi'a, taƙaitaccen PDF da ajiyar bayanai mai inganci. An gina shi don amfanin kai da na shugabanni.<
>Convert audio to text in real-time using advanced AI speech recognition\. Designed to unlock actionable insights from audio data and enhance customer and[^<]+

>Juya sauti zuwa rubutu a lokaci guda ta hanyar gane magana ta AI mai ci gaba. An tsara shi don fitar da fahimta mai amfani daga bayanan sauti da inganta hulɗa da abokan ciniki da ayyukan yau da kullum.<
Open-source Rust projects across serialisation, logging, code generation, math, and developer tooling — including the static site generator behind this site\.
Ayyukan Rust na buɗaɗɗen tushe a fannin tsara bayanai, shiga rajista, ƙirƙirar kod, lissafi da kayan aikin masu haɓakawa — haɗe da janaretan shafukan tsaye da ke bayan wannan shafin.
Starter templates, two industry-focused publications, a CSS framework, and the dotfiles that keep a development environment reproducible\.
Samfuran farawa, wallafe-wallafe biyu na masana'antu, tsarin CSS, da fayilolin dot da ke sa yanayin haɓakawa ya kasance mai maimaituwa.
